<script setup lang="ts">
import { CheckboxRoot as ArkCheckboxRoot } from '@ark-ui/vue/checkbox';
import type { CheckboxRootEmits, CheckboxRootProps } from '@ark-ui/vue/checkbox';
import { clsx } from 'clsx';
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue';
import styles from './Checkbox.module.css';

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });

export type CheckboxSize = 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl';

export interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ CheckboxRootProps {
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class'];
  size?: CheckboxSize;
}

export interface Emits extends /* @vue-ignore */ CheckboxRootEmits {}

const { class: className, size = 'md' } = defineProps<Props>();
defineEmits<Emits>();
defineSlots<{ default?: () => unknown }>();

const attrs = useAttrs();
</script>

<template>
  <ArkCheckboxRoot
    v-bind="attrs"
    :class="clsx(styles.root, className)"
    :data-size="size"
    data-slot="checkbox-root"
  >
    <slot />
  </ArkCheckboxRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { CheckboxRootProvider as ArkCheckboxRootProvider } from '@ark-ui/vue/checkbox';
import type { CheckboxRootProviderProps } from '@ark-ui/vue/checkbox';
import { clsx } from 'clsx';
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue';
import styles from './Checkbox.module.css';
import type { CheckboxSize } from './Checkbox.vue';

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });

export interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ CheckboxRootProviderProps {
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class'];
  size?: CheckboxSize;
  value: CheckboxRootProviderProps['value'];
}

const { class: className, size = 'md', value } = defineProps<Props>();
defineSlots<{ default?: () => unknown }>();

const attrs = useAttrs();
</script>

<template>
  <ArkCheckboxRootProvider
    v-bind="attrs"
    :class="clsx(styles.root, className)"
    :data-size="size"
    :value="value"
    data-slot="checkbox-root-provider"
  >
    <slot />
  </ArkCheckboxRootProvider>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { CheckboxControl as ArkCheckboxControl } from '@ark-ui/vue/checkbox';

    v-bind="attrs"

    <slot>
      <CheckboxIndicator />
      <CheckboxIndicator indeterminate />

<script setup lang="ts">
import { CheckboxIndicator as ArkCheckboxIndicator } from '@ark-ui/vue/checkbox';
import type { CheckboxIndicatorProps } from '@ark-ui/vue/checkbox';
import { clsx } from 'clsx';
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue';
import { CheckIcon, IndeterminateIcon } from '@/lib/moduix/icons/ui';
import styles from './Checkbox.module.css';

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });

export interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ CheckboxIndicatorProps {
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class'];
  indeterminate?: CheckboxIndicatorProps['indeterminate'];
}

const { class: className, indeterminate = undefined } = defineProps<Props>();
defineSlots<{ default?: () => unknown }>();

const attrs = useAttrs();
</script>

<template>
  <ArkCheckboxIndicator
    v-bind="attrs"
    :class="clsx(styles.indicator, className)"
    :indeterminate="indeterminate"
    data-slot="checkbox-indicator"
  >
    <slot>
      <IndeterminateIcon v-if="indeterminate" />
      <CheckIcon v-else />
    </slot>
  </ArkCheckboxIndicator>
</template>
